response.sql:
WITH grp AS (
  SELECT s.zoneref,
         si.typesite,
         AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press,
         AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite
)
SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio,
       AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute
FROM grp;

assumptions.assumption: chronotag is compared as text, as the request specifies, so the string literals are matched lexically against the stored values. The request settles this, so the column's declared TIMESTAMP type is not used for conversion.
A scan with spanmin = 0 has no computable size-per-minute value, so NULLIF treats it as missing rather than letting the division fail.

Scans whose site has a NULL typesite form their own group, since they match a site by code. Groups with no non-null values for a metric are left out of that metric's outer average, as AVG does by default.

alternatives.interpretation: Exclude scans whose matched site has no site type (typesite IS NULL), so only groups with a known site type are averaged.

  SELECT s.zoneref,
         si.typesite,
         AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_press,
         AVG(s.gbsize / NULLIF(s.spanmin, 0)) AS avg_size_per_min
  FROM scans s
  JOIN sites si ON si.zoneregistry = s.zoneref
  WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274'
    AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797'
    AND si.typesite IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite
)
SELECT AVG(avg_press) AS avg_compression_ratio,
       AVG(avg_size_per_min) AS avg_size_per_minute
FROM grp;
